_comment: Representative Claude Code MCP entries for the four codebase-context tools compared in the article. Confirm the exact command/args in each project's README before use — invocations change between releases. Merge the entries you want into your real .mcp.json (or run each tool's own installer, which writes these for you).

code-review-graph._note: pip/pipx install, then `code-review-graph install` auto-writes this for every detected agent. Shown here so you can see what it configures. Local-first, no keys.

token-savior._note: MCP structural-nav + memory server. Representative npx form — check the repo for the current package name. No cloud keys required.

claude-context._note: Zilliz semantic vector search. REQUIRES a cloud vector DB + an OpenAI embedding key. This is the local-first dealbreaker called out in the article — your code's embeddings leave the box.
